advantages.title: Light Weight
advantages.copy: Manufactured from aluminium Alyspan is easy to cut on site and light weight making it ideal for the "DIY" Home Owner or Handyman building an outdoor patio or living area.

advantages.title: Easy to Cut
advantages.copy: Cut to length on site with standard tools — no welding, no hot works, no specialist trade required to make a beam fit.

advantages.title: Excellent Appearance
advantages.copy: Alyspan Beams are Powder coated in a Hi-Gloss finish providing an excellent finish to the project.

advantages.title: Maintenance Free
advantages.copy: Aluminium will not rust. The powder coated finish holds its colour in coastal and high-exposure sites with no repainting cycle.

advantages.title: Long Spans Based on Unique Beam Design
advantages.copy: The fluted profile carries load further between posts — fewer columns, cleaner sightlines and a more open outdoor room.

faq.q: What size aluminium patio beams does Alyspan come in?
faq.a: Alyspan is available in both 100mm x 50mm and 150mm x 50mm beam sizes at lengths to suit your application. The 100 x 50 beam is supplied in 6.5m lengths and the 150 x 50 in 8.0m lengths, and both cut down on site.

faq.q: What aluminium alloy are Alyspan beams made from?
faq.a: Both Alyspan sections are extruded from 6063 – T6 aluminium. The 100 x 50 has an area of 599 mm² and weighs 1.635 kg/m; the 150 x 50 has an area of 759 mm² and weighs 2.072 kg/m.

faq.q: Do Alyspan beams comply with Australian Standards?
faq.a: All structural sections comply with Australian standards for Structural Design, Aluminium Structures and Wind Loads for housing — AS 1170.0, AS 1170.1, AS 1170.2, AS 4055 – 2006 and AS 1664 – 1997. The span tables are certified by Ross Engineers, Practicing Structural Engineers.

faq.q: How far can an Alyspan aluminium beam span?
faq.a: It depends on load width and wind classification. For a single span with no overhang and a maximum adjacent building height of 4.8m, a 150 x 50 beam spans up to 5100mm in N1 and N2 at a 1500mm load width. Full span tables for overhangs, continuous spans and 12.0m building heights are in the downloadable PDF.

faq.q: Can I cut Alyspan beams on site?
faq.a: Yes. Manufactured from aluminium Alyspan is easy to cut on site and light weight making it ideal for the "DIY" Home Owner or Handyman building an outdoor patio or living area.

faq.q: What colours are Alyspan beams and brackets available in?
faq.a: Beams and posts are stocked in Mill and Pearl White, and brackets in Gal and Pearl White, with Monument also available. Beams available in other colours — check for lead time and colours at time of order.
